TD LABeauty Affiliate Program –

 Join the Revolution in Clean, Curly Hair Care & Beauty!

Welcome to TD LABeauty—where science meets self-care! Created by a chemist with a passion for clean beauty, TD LABeauty offers carefully formulated products that nourish, protect, and enhance natural beauty from the inside out.

Specializing in curly hair care and unique beauty solutions, TD LABeauty uses probiotic ingredients and plant-based formulas to provide deeply nourishing, transformative results for hair and skin.

Our standout products include the pH Lip Oil, a color-changing lip gloss that adapts to your pH for a unique tint, and the My Hair Secret line for curly hair, which combines the power of probiotics with sulfate-free, deeply hydrating ingredients. Every product is designed to help our customers feel confident, naturally beautiful, and empowered in their own skin.

 By joining the TD LABeauty Affiliate Program, you’re partnering with a brand that’s all about authenticity, health-conscious beauty, and visible results. As an affiliate, you’ll earn competitive commissions, exclusive access to new product launches, and support from a team that’s dedicated to your success. Plus, our eye-catching products and effective formulations make promoting TD LABeauty easy and rewarding. Let’s make an impact together! Partner with TD LABeauty and share products your audience will love and trust.

Join us in our mission to bring clean, effective beauty to the world, one product at a time.

TD LABeauty Affiliate Program Overview

Product Descriptions

  1. pH Lip Oil •Description: The pH Lip Oil is a color-changing lip gloss that adapts to your natural pH for a personalized tint. This lightweight, hydrating formula leaves lips soft, full, and smooth with a beautiful, long-lasting shine. • Key Ingredients: Color-reactive pigments, natural oils. • Benefits: Moisturizes and plumps lips, provides a unique tint, lasts all day.
  2. My Hair Secret Shampoo for Curly Hair • Description: A sulfate-free, gentle cleanser formulated specifically for curly hair. Enriched with 15 Ayurvedic herbs and probiotics, it cleanses while nourishing curls, leaving them frizz-free and manageable. • Key Ingredients: Ayurvedic herbal extracts, probiotics. • Benefits: Defines curls, reduces frizz, supports scalp health.
  3.  3. My Hair Secret Conditioner for Curly Hair • Description: This rich conditioner uses probiotics to deeply nourish curls, restoring moisture and shine. Perfect for enhancing curl definition and taming frizz. • Key Ingredients: Probiotics, moisturizing botanicals. • Benefits: Hydrates and detangles curls, reduces frizz, adds shine.
  4.  4. My Hair Secret Leave-In Conditioner for Curly Hair • Description: A leave-in conditioner that offers hydration and frizz control for curls, with probiotics to balance and nourish each strand. • Key Ingredients: Probiotics, lightweight oils. • Benefits: Enhances curl definition, detangles, and fights humidity.
  5.  5. My Hair Secret Deep Mask for Curly Hair • Description: A deeply nourishing mask packed with probiotics and plant-based nutrients to repair and revitalize curls from the roots. • Key Ingredients: Probiotics, rich botanical extracts. • Benefits: Provides intense hydration, strengthens curls, reduces breakage.
  6.  6. My Hair Secret Curly Cream for Curly Hair • Description: This curl cream defines and enhances curls, giving them a soft hold and beautiful shape while minimizing frizz. • Key Ingredients: Probiotics, curl-enhancing botanicals. • Benefits: Defines and smooths curls, provides a soft hold, controls frizz.
  7.  7. My Hair Secret Oil for Curly Hair • Description: A nourishing oil that locks in moisture and adds shine, perfect for protecting curly hair and enhancing its natural texture. • Key Ingredients: Probiotics, natural oils. • Benefits: Seals in moisture, adds shine, supports healthy hair growth.
  8. Unique Selling Points (USPs) • Science-Backed Formulas: Created by a chemist, each product is crafted for maximum effectiveness with safe, high-quality ingredients. • Clean, Probiotic-Powered: We use probiotics and natural ingredients that nourish and strengthen hair and skin. • Tailored for Curly Hair: Our hair care line is specifically formulated to enhance and care for curly hair, offering moisture, definition, and frizz control. • Personalized Lip Care: Our pH Lip Oil provides a unique color tailored to each individual’s pH level for a custom look. •
  9. Eco-Conscious: We prioritize sustainability and environmentally friendly practices in our packaging and ingredients. Affiliate Payment Terms • Commission Structure: Earn competitive commissions on each sale made through your referral link. • Payment Frequency: Affiliates are paid monthly, with payments processed on the first of each month. • Payment Methods: Affiliates can choose to be paid via PayPal or bank transfer. Note that PayPal is typically faster and preferred for international affiliates. • Minimum Payout Threshold: Payouts are made once affiliates reach a minimum of $50 in commissions. Any commissions below this threshold will roll over to the next month. • Referral Tracking: Each affiliate will receive a unique referral link with cookies lasting 30 days, ensuring they earn commissions even if the customer returns later. If you’re ready to start earning by sharing TD LABeauty’s innovative products, sign up for our affiliate program and be part of our growing community!
